user.title: Add WristWand
user.description: WristWand lets an Amazfit / Zepp OS watch control things you point at. After adding it, open WristWand on the watch and choose Pair: Home Assistant will show a pairing code to enter on the watch.

abort.single_instance_allowed: WristWand is already set up. Pair more watches from the watch itself.

init.title: Paired watches
init.description: {count} watch(es) are paired. Select any to remove; a removed watch has to pair again.

abort.no_watches: No watches are paired yet. Open WristWand on the watch and choose Pair.
